It can be justified because human pair-bonding is literally human nature; marriage didn't always exist, and human sexual relationships predate it.
Sex before marriage helps create a bond and makess the relationship strong.

If you are with someone and you consent to this, then that is your choice. It only matter if both parties are consenting to the act and don't feel pressured.
